name: Canh chua
summary: Canh chua is a dinner soup in downtown Can Tho on Vietnam Tourism’s four-day piece, and a different wording on the Can Tho place page. The place page says Can Tho sour soup with sesbania sesban flower and henicorhynchus, bông điên điển and cá linh. The four-day piece says fish or shrimp, pineapple, tomato, sprouts, and elephant-ear stems. Do not fold those into one recipe.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s place page ties the sesbania and cá linh bowl to Can Tho. The four-day piece calls the pineapple bowl native to the region and eats it downtown. Sở Văn hóa, Thể thao và Du lịch thành phố Cần Thơ says flood season brings cá linh and many ways of cooking it, and does not print a method.
howToEat: At dinner in town, on the four-day piece.
Place-page bowl: bông điên điển and cá linh.
Four-day bowl: fish or shrimp, pineapple, tomato, sprouts, and elephant-ear stems.
seoDescription: Two Can Tho sour soups on Vietnam Tourism: bông điên điển with cá linh, and a pineapple bowl with fish or shrimp.
